Connect jump pack to battery under hood.
Start engine or reach at least accessory mode, press brake, shift to N.

Apply parking brake.
Restore 12V power via jump pack — battery under hood.
Start engine or accessory mode, press brake, shift to N on column/button selector.
If power cannot be restored: FLATBED ONLY with front wheel dollies.
4WD/AWD: FLATBED REQUIRED — never tow by front wheels only.

issues.title: No Cabin Neutral Override (2019+) — Power Required
issues.detail: The 2019+ Silverado 1500 uses an electronic shifter with a hydraulically controlled park pawl. There is no shift lock release accessible from the cabin. GM's owner's manual (p.411) explicitly states it cannot be released with a low/dead battery. GM shop tool DT-52910 is required for manual park release and must be used on a lift. Always restore 12V power first. Flatbed with dollies is the field solution.

shiftLock.slot: Pre-2020 (column shift): shift interlock slot on the STEERING COLUMN housing — lower-left face. 2020+ (electronic selector): NO CABIN OVERRIDE — restore 12V power first. Dead battery: FLATBED with wheel dollies.
steps: IDENTIFY YEAR AND SHIFTER TYPE FIRST.

PRE-2020 (column shift): Turn ignition to ON. Locate shift lock slot on lower-left face of steering column. Insert flathead, press firmly. Press brake. Move lever to N. Requires at least 9V — jump pack if battery is low.
2020+ (electronic selector): RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST. Connect jump pack. Start engine or accessory mode. Press brake. Shift to N.

HEAVY VEHICLE: Use properly rated wheel blocks, straps, and chains. Verify your equipment weight rating before attempting to load or lift.
DIESEL: Same shift-lock and tow procedures as gasoline variant. Heavier curb weight — account for extra weight in equipment ratings.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.

battery.location: Under hood, driver side. Duramax diesel trims (2001+ LB7, LLY, LBZ, LMM, LML, L5P): DUAL BATTERIES — both under hood, both on driver side. Connect jump pack to the POSITIVE post closest to the firewall on the primary (driver-side front) battery.
battery.jumpPoints: Under hood: jump to positive (+) terminal on either battery. Ground (−) to engine block or frame.
battery.warning: Diesel trims may have two 12V batteries in parallel. Jump to either positive terminal. Heavy vehicle — verify equipment ratings.

alerts.warning: 4WD: transfer case to 2H.

Apply parking brake and chock wheels.

If power cannot be restored, use the shift lock slot above — Cap at side of console shifter base.
TRANSFER CASE: must be shifted to 2WD/2H before towing. IF BATTERY IS DEAD: jump battery FIRST, shift TC to 2WD, then disconnect. If TC cannot be shifted: FLATBED ONLY.

issues.title: No Cabin Neutral Override (2021+) — Electric Parking Brake Complication
issues.detail: The 2021+ Suburban/Tahoe has no cabin shift lock release. With a hydraulic park pawl and electronic button shifting, it cannot be moved without power. Additionally, if the manual park release is used while powered, the electric parking brake will automatically engage as a safety feature — requiring caliper connectors to be unplugged or the EPB fuse to be pulled before the vehicle will roll. Flatbed with wheel dollies is the safest field solution.

steps: Turn ignition key to ON (do not start engine) — this powers the interlock solenoid.
Press the brake pedal firmly.
Move the floor selector from Park to Neutral.

shiftLock.slot: NO simple accessible slot. Requires console disassembly: remove LEFT-side leather console trim panel (pull off retaining clips), remove console storage lid, pry up the shifter console surround — then insert long flathead behind the BTSI solenoid lock rod and push rearward ~½ inch. ALTERNATIVE: underbody — remove 10mm nut from shift lever on side of transmission, push lever two clicks forward to reach Neutral.
steps: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — strongly preferred. Connect jump pack to battery in rear cargo area.
Once powered, press brake and move selector to N normally.

WITH PARTIAL POWER — service mode method: Foot OFF brake, press and HOLD Start button for ~8-10 seconds until lights/chimes activate. This enters service/accessory mode (equivalent to key-in-ignition ON position). Release Start button. Now press brake and shift selector to N normally. When done, move back to Park and press Start (no brake) to exit service mode.
WITHOUT POWER — console disassembly method:
Pull off the LEFT-side leather trim panel on the center console (retaining clips only — no tools).
Remove the console storage lid/bin.
Pry up the shifter console surround carefully to expose the BTSI solenoid assembly.
Insert a long-blade flathead (4-6 inch) behind the solenoid lock rod.
Push the lock rod rearward approximately ½ inch to release — takes very little force.
Press brake. Move selector to N.
WITHOUT POWER — underbody method (easier if vehicle is accessible):
Crawl under the rear of the vehicle. Locate the 10mm nut on the shift lever on the side of the transmission.
Remove the nut. Push the lever two clicks toward the front of the vehicle to reach Neutral.
BATTERY LOCATION: rear cargo area under the floor panel (not under hood).
Apply parking brake.
Jump pack connects to rear trunk battery — open hatch, pull carpet from passenger side wall, lift foam cover, access (+) and (-) terminals.
Once powered, press brake and select N.
No power: console disassembly or underbody transmission lever method.
CARBON FIBER body panels — use soft straps only. No hooks on body.

battery.location: REAR TRUNK — right (passenger) side of rear cargo area under carpet and foam cover. NOT in the frunk. Open hatch, pull carpet away from right wall, lift foam cover to access battery terminals.
battery.jumpPoints: Inside the frunk — standard red (+) / black (−) terminals on battery
battery.warning: Many operators waste time looking for the battery in the engine bay. It is NOT there. Open the hood — the frunk IS the storage area. Very low clearance — flatbed only.

alerts.warning: FLATBED ONLY. Extremely low clearance. Load from REAR only.
alerts.notes: Battery is in the REAR TRUNK (right rear under carpet). Z06, Grand Sport, ZR1: same.

issues.title: Battery in Frunk — Not Engine Bay
issues.detail: The C7 Corvette has a front trunk (frunk) where the battery is located, NOT in the engine bay. Operators who don't know this will waste significant time looking for jump terminals. Open the hood and look in the front storage compartment.

issues.title: Extremely Low Ground Clearance
issues.detail: Standard ground clearance is approximately 4.5 inches. Lowered or Z51 variants are even lower. Any approach angle to a flatbed must be carefully managed with ramps or approach plates. Load from rear only — never winch from front over a standard ramp angle.

issues.title: Carbon Ceramic Brakes — No Metal-to-Metal Contact
issues.detail: Many C7 Z06 and Grand Sport trims have carbon ceramic brake rotors. These are extremely expensive ($15,000+). Never use metal wheel chocks directly against the rotors. Use rubber-padded chocks only.

issues.title: No Accessible Cabin Shift Lock Slot — Console Disassembly Required
issues.detail: The C7 Corvette has no simple shift lock override slot accessible from the cabin. To shift without power, either: (1) Remove the left console leather trim, storage lid, and pry up the shifter surround to access the BTSI solenoid rod — push rearward ~½ inch with a long flathead screwdriver. Or (2) remove the 10mm nut from the shift lever on the transmission underbody and push the lever two clicks forward. Battery is in the rear cargo area — not under the hood.

shiftLock.slot: NO MECHANICAL OVERRIDE. C8 uses an 8-speed DCT — requires 12V power to shift. Battery access: front trunk (frunk) — lift floor mat. Connect jump pack to frunk battery terminals. Once powered, press brake and select N.
steps: C8 uses an 8-speed DCT (dual-clutch transmission) — REQUIRES 12V POWER to shift. No mechanical override.
RESTORE 12V POWER: open the front trunk (frunk). Lift the floor mat to expose the battery.
Connect jump pack to the battery terminals in the frunk.

issues.title: Mid-Engine — Battery Behind Passenger Seat
issues.detail: Unlike all previous Corvettes, the C8 is mid-engine. The 12V battery is located behind the passenger seat or in the front storage area — NOT in the engine bay. There is no frunk battery on most C8 trims.

issues.title: Absolutely No Winching From Front or Rear Bumper
issues.detail: The C8 front and rear fascias have virtually zero structural tolerance for winching. Damage to the carbon fiber body panels is extremely costly. Use only designated tow hooks — front tow hook is accessed through the front fascia opening on the driver side.

issues.title: Extremely Low Ground Clearance
issues.detail: Ground clearance is approximately 4.5 inches stock. Z06 and ZR1 trims may be lower. Use approach ramps or extended ramps for flatbed loading. Approach angle is critical.

issues.title: E-Ray Hybrid AWD
issues.detail: C8 E-Ray (2024+) is a hybrid AWD. FLATBED ONLY for E-Ray. 12V terminals only — never access the HV front axle motor system.

issues.title: DCT Requires Power — Very Low Clearance
issues.detail: The C8 Corvette has an 8-speed DCT that requires 12V power to shift reliably. The vehicle also has extremely low ground clearance — wheel-lift towing risks underside damage. Flatbed with ramp is strongly preferred. For E-Ray AWD: flatbed only.

Move the passenger seat fully rearward.
Remove the RIGHT-side console access panel — pull it straight toward you. 6 retaining clips.

Insert a long-blade flathead (4-6 inch) behind the rod. Push rearward ~½ inch. Very little force needed.
Press brake. Move selector to N.

Remove upper console panel first (trim tool). Then lower panel — slide rearward before pulling outward.
Once panels removed, same long flathead behind solenoid rod, push rearward ~½ inch.
